_about: Mechanical assertions for an extraction of sample_camp.html. 'rows' are the staged rows for org_id 'tumblestone-brook'; 'org_facts' is the row written by `staging.py add-org`. A row 'match' selects a row by exact start_date. Equality assertions compare exact strings; 'blank' means the empty string. Times in this project are zero-padded 'HH:MM AM'.
page_text_normalisation: Page text = the HTML with <script>, <style> and tags removed, character entities decoded, and runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, trimmed. A source_quote is verbatim when it is a substring of that text after the same whitespace collapsing.

description_not_copied.note: No sentence of the description (split on '.', '!' or '?', trimmed, case-insensitive) may equal a sentence of the page text, and no run of 8 or more consecutive words may appear in both.

org_facts.note: financial_aid_available and financial_aid_notes must be blank: the page says nothing about aid.

must_not: Any end_time value anywhere (the page gives no clock time for the end of the day; 'mid-afternoon' is not a time).
Any row built from the 2026 testimonial (June 29 - July 3, 2026).
A start_date or end_date taken or shifted from a 2026 date.
